ko.executive_summary: Qualcomm will license patents for Huawei's LogicFolding chip architecture. Apple, Qualcomm, and MediaTek are pursuing different 2nm routes to enable 30B-parameter AI model execution on smartphones.
key_facts: Qualcomm to license Huawei LogicFolding patents
Apple, Qualcomm, MediaTek implementing 2nm AI solutions

implications.text: Qualcomm-Huawei patent deal signals openness to architectural innovation beyond traditional IP walls in mobile SoC design.
Multiple vendors pursuing 2nm process for large language model inference on-device, fragmenting the approach landscape.

ko.counterpoint: Different architectural routes may hinder ecosystem standardization and software optimization across platforms.
